artifact.receipt: Source and built TUI hashes captured before launch and verified unchanged after the final frame assertions. The uncommitted source hashes identify this validation build.

scope: Actual stock TUI, actual sidebar, real PTY mark/pin/collapse, native child question/permission from deterministic loopback provider.
checks: Marked pinned parent retains completion while displaying child busy/question.
Collapsed All sessions retains busy/question summary.
From a separate idle session route, narrow 88x24 browse retains completion and question footer; session menu retains busy/question labels.
Question reply transitions to native permission with mark and collapsed summary retained.
Permission reply clears attention and busy labels without clearing completion.
limitations: No external provider or model inference; native host tool handling receives synthetic loopback completion chunks.
No native retry, remote disconnect, cross-platform render, or performance claim from this focused smoke.
